author: Albert Mulder
releaseNotes:
0.1.2 - New attributes: catWeight (from the box's scale, lb or kg via the new Weight unit preference), lastVisitDuration (seconds), visitsToday (on boxes that report it) and fault (none, motor, program or g-sensor).
0.1.1 - Cat detection: the device is now a Motion Sensor (motion active while the cat is at or in the box, inactive when it leaves), so cat visits can trigger rules and dashboards.
0.1.0 - Initial release. Local control of the Tuya Smart Cat Litter Box 04 ZY (Smart Life / Tuya Smart app) over Tuya protocol 3.5, no cloud needed: clean, empty, auto mode, deodorize, infrared sensor, child lock, clumping time, cleaning interval, bin calibration and litter leveling, with live status. Needs each box's IP, Device ID and Local Key; the README and the preferences page explain how to get them from a free Tuya developer account.
